question: In a row of 47 students facing North, Sonika is 18th from the left end. If Dhruv is 11th to the right of Sonika, what is Dhruv's position from the right-end of the line?
solution:
Given: 47 students facing North

Sonika is 18th from the left end.

Dhruv is 11th to the right of Sonika

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0431e5392b7caeda7091306a402c409c1c1c5ede029876cc4adca8f535e06062.png] 

So, Position(Right) = Total students - Position(Left) + 1

Position(Right) = 47 - 29 + 1 = 19th

So, Dhruv's position from the right-end of the line is 19th.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
